HEADS UP, MOTORISTS!

The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) announced the suspension of the expanded number coding scheme on Friday, June 6, 2025, to make way for Eid’l Adha.

President Marcos has declared June 6 a regular holiday nationwide in observance of Eid’l Adha or the Feast of Sacrifice, one of the two greatest feasts of Islam. (Facebook/MMDA)
